turns.message: I bought a Casio analogue men's watch worth Rs. 2,995 on Flipkart on October 14, 2021. After it was shipped I got a message that the order was cancelled because of a product price error. I placed the same order a second time; that was also cancelled and I was told a refund would be processed. I complained on the National Consumer Helpline. Flipkart then placed a new order itself, showing an amount of Rs 15,000, but I never received it, and my original payment has not been refunded.

expected.rationale: Refund pending with an exact purchase date, and the story does not state that the platform's support was contacted. Rule outcome; the National Consumer Helpline complaint is not a modelled fact.
